scope: .cairn/changes/nested-session-protocol: finite grammar with bounded unfolding, duality, the abstract move-only endpoint resource and a bounded mailbox. Definitions table is handwritten; no lowering/runtime/peer correspondence; the only progress statement is guest-local; the balanced table's unbounded trace language sendⁿ·recvⁿ is not regular and needs a return stack, while this model admits it only up to the declared stack limit; the legacy depth-only control drops returns; delegation excluded.
